result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Gusto is one of the best overall payroll platforms** because it's easy to use, automates payroll tax calculations and filings, and offers employee self-service, benefits administration, and HR tools.

However, the best choice depends heavily on where your business operates. Since you're in Ontario, Canada, I'd distinguish between Canadian payroll software and US-focused options—many popular recommendations like Gusto and OnPay are primarily designed for US businesses.

## Best payroll software to consider

![Canada bank holidays and processing deadlines – Wagepoint](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BeLrJTSa5EcYGruwCn3ZDIxMUlfcXvUOAWq-VkLCLOXdz1jzkCEyci0fWXdrXgftGn6W2rYz-lwC8Y0IoRwsfjD4UWeNALSFIPbehrCIgAbl20XbCFLJPYeU7ALSuo1T_gE3VKm0vx7ep4xL3fMx4B0KmoO2Sjhoyl0a8jBEmmu8q-IbjKKE4gQp0SBNRaHp?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Wagepoint**

(Best overall for small Canadian businesses)

- Canadian payroll and CRA remittances
- CPP, EI and income tax calculations
- Direct deposit, T4s and Records of Employment
- Starting around \$20 CAD/month plus employee fees

Best for businesses wanting straightforward payroll without a complicated HR system.

[Wagepoint website](https://www.wagepoint.com/)

---

![Is QuickBooks Payroll Right For Your Small Business?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NxI61jHfD25H_nt8kRcYvHyRVuiwRzu6bQoayYIiX-p8_Tdm33tn9Kts01QntZfj3zQN9yJXydB71M2ZINU7Ryd1ra3_ou6nxuFmt_RR05RvmT9fmlWNmhedpXNBD2J0wX0aBNjOVffTjzvTAmAF2cn-1xTxGvSaxPrmNctmVLRRLezMTFbi5A9igGYQVZtF?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Payroll and bookkeeping together
- CRA remittances and T4s
- Employee self-service
- Great if you already use QuickBooks Online

[QuickBooks Canada website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/payroll/)

---

![Payworks - Made In Canada Directory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JDMxoSeGQxMxiFL1WlmiX5yAKI9xRuaDUfQb6s6QcfAxTFJFbnN2kRi-gEYbnnOG4PrWAZTFpn3xs21LhDWxnQbK2WD_IFUqHaSdFe_RAXAGW3S0REiMzKGkkZ8KZy6JjkEu468uzREKIBJ8oxcvN3ufTsXg2JM7b6x4a2BhfAvpRoWj75NBPNUO2vBVAHLK?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Payworks**

(Best for personalized support)

- Canadian payroll expertise
- Payroll, HR and time tracking
- Support for more complicated payroll requirements

[Payworks website](https://www.payworks.ca/)

---

![Knit People EOR Review - Pricing, Features & Alternatives](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hrUsl4qoGymjOdp99iMOrjyzqM314jcGnbzEghcUIRuiohQrKKFJZszH5TJLBmeG9woWE4v4kAs1837Cnu7z7qtnnXMP-J0JOVY8YTYT4lutHMKo310U3Jqma7pRnyF4HuFifrJySPzyFN_K7_Rdiuf5s5akGTv1L94bfXF76vuvQ_-YYXbRUY6JItB3nMfY?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Knit**

- Payroll and basic HR in one platform
- Employee onboarding and time-off tracking
- Useful for growing teams

[Knit website](https://www.knitpeople.com/)

These Canadian options and their relative strengths are supported by recent 2026 comparisons. I'd start by comparing Wagepoint and QuickBooks Payroll. Wagepoint is my first choice if payroll simplicity is the priority; QuickBooks wins if you already use its accounting software.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
